import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Peaking AI models are trained on extensive code repositories and can generate, explain, debug, and refactor code across all major programming languages.

## Recommended models

| Task | Model | Why |
|------|-------|-----|
| Complex generation, architecture | Peak-1 Pro | Deepest reasoning, best code quality |
| General coding, scripts, utilities | Peak-1 | Fast and capable for most tasks |
| Code review, linting, classification | Peak-1 Flash | Low latency, cost effective |

## Code generation

<Tabs>
  <TabItem label="Python">
  ```python
  response = client.chat.create(
      model="peak-1-pro",
      messages=[
          {"role": "system", "content": "Write clean, well-documented Python code."},
          {"role": "user", "content": "Implement a thread-safe LRU cache with TTL support."}
      ],
      temperature=0
  )
  ```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="JavaScript">
  ```javascript
  const response = await client.chat.create({
    model: 'peak-1-pro',
    messages: [
      { role: 'system', content: 'Write clean, well-documented TypeScript code.' },
      { role: 'user', content: 'Implement a thread-safe LRU cache with TTL support.' }
    ],
    temperature: 0
  });
  ```
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Code review

Analyze existing code for bugs, performance issues, and improvements:

```python
code = """
def process_data(items):
    results = []
    for item in items:
        if item['status'] == 'active':
            result = expensive_computation(item)
            results.append(result)
    return sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['score'], reverse=True)[:10]
"""

response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1-pro",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are an expert code reviewer. Identify bugs, performance issues, and suggest improvements."},
        {"role": "user", "content": f"Review this code:\n\n```python\n{code}\n```"}
    ]
)
```

## Code transformation

Refactor, translate between languages, or modernize codebases:

```python
response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "Convert code between programming languages. Preserve logic and use idiomatic patterns in the target language."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Convert this Python to Rust:\n\n```python\ndef fibonacci(n):\n    if n <= 1:\n        return n\n    return fibonacci(n-1) + fibonacci(n-2)\n```"}
    ]
)
```

## Best practices

:::tip
- Set `temperature: 0` for deterministic, reproducible code generation
- Use system prompts to enforce coding standards and style guides
- Provide context about the broader codebase when asking for integration code
- Use Peak-1 Pro for complex tasks; Peak-1 Flash for simple completions
:::
